stories.headline: Paine Launches 2026-27 NBA Elo Forecast and Player Ratings
stories.summary: Analyst Neil Paine has released his 2026-27 NBA season forecasts, featuring updated Elo ratings, game predictions, and LAKER player leaderboards. This year's model introduces fully refitted constants derived from over 77,000 historical game logs dating back to 1946-47. The system utilizes a dual-track memory approach, separating volatile regular-season form from slower-evolving playoff performance metrics.

stories.headline: Basketball Intelligence Drops Latest NBA Analysis and G League Insights
stories.summary: The November 14 newsletter compiles the best current NBA reporting and analysis from across the web. Features include league-wide assessments of struggling teams, power rankings, star duos, and spotlights on G League prospects and tryout economics.

stories.headline: Paine Drops 2026 NFL Odds Tracker, Elo Ratings, and Player Metrics
stories.summary: Analyst Neil Paine has published his comprehensive 2026 NFL data hub, compiling power rankings, prediction-market odds, and game leverage metrics. The tracker also features team Elo projections alongside specialized quarterback EPA values and in-season Approximate Value player rankings.

stories.headline: The Gospel Coalition Examines Biblical Christology
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition features theological essays and commentary examining the divine nature of Jesus as presented in scripture. The collection connects ancient scriptural interpretation with contemporary Christian thought and teaching.

stories.headline: MacBook Pro OLED Display Issues
stories.summary: Early adopters of the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display are reporting physical discomfort, including eye strain, dizziness, and nausea. The complaints suggest that Apple's specific implementation of OLED dimming technology may be causing these adverse reactions for some users.

stories.headline: Meta's VR Tech as a Vision Pro Alternative
stories.summary: Marques Brownlee explores how Meta's current VR hardware features offer a glimpse into what a potential Apple Vision Pro 2 could have delivered. The discussion highlights specific technological implementations in Meta's lineup that contrast with Apple's current headset capabilities.

stories.headline: Marques Brownlee Ranks Halloween Candy
stories.summary: Marques Brownlee provides a subjective ranking of various Halloween candies in a lighthearted video segment. The content focuses on his personal preferences and evaluations of classic holiday treats.

stories.headline: Apple Refreshes The iPad Mini With OLED And A Price Hike
stories.summary: The newly refreshed iPad Mini brings an OLED display and a significant price increase. The device also introduces a heavily layered lineup structure for buyers to navigate.

stories.headline: Do You Know These Foldables?
Bet you didn't know what we shot the intro on
Strategies for Engaging Young Adults in Faith
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition offers resources and essays aimed at addressing the spiritual needs of young adults. The platform provides theological perspectives and practical guidance for church leaders looking to better connect with this demographic.

stories.headline: England Faces Ultimate Test Against Spain Under Tuchel
stories.summary: England travels to Madrid to face European champions Spain in a high-stakes Nations League match that will test their progress under manager Thomas Tuchel. Spain enters the fixture on an imposing 43-game unbeaten run, offering the visiting squad a definitive benchmark of their current standing.

stories.headline: Analyst Suggests Apple’s Johny Srouji as Ideal Successor for NVIDIA
stories.summary: Commentary highlights Apple hardware chief Johny Srouji as a prime candidate to lead NVIDIA should the top job open up. Analysts note his extensive silicon expertise and past consideration for major executive roles make him a formidable contender for the position.

stories.headline: Trump, Putin, and Xi Plan Historic Trilateral Meeting in China
stories.summary: The White House announced that President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping will hold a historic joint meeting during the APEC summit in Shenzhen next week. Discussions are expected to focus on global nuclear weapons reduction, though no formal agreements are anticipated from the talks.

stories.headline: The Festive Attire We Really Need
Reviewing Paul C. Gutjahr’s 'Faith in Space'
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition reviews Paul C. Gutjahr’s book 'Faith in Space,' exploring theological perspectives on extraterrestrial life. The piece is part of the publication's ongoing essays addressing faith, history, and modern cultural questions.

stories.headline: Drawing Parallels Between Mordecai and Joseph
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition publishes a biblical reflection comparing the Old Testament figures Mordecai and Joseph. The essay analyzes their similar trajectories of suffering, rise to power, and ultimate preservation of God's people.

stories.headline: Guidance for Abuse Survivors to Process War‑Era Trauma
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition essay explores how counselors can help survivors of abuse who grew up amid conflict understand their past, offering practical steps to contextualize trauma and foster healing.

stories.headline: Basketball Intelligence For 11/15/26
Tim Hardaway Sr. Insists Mavericks Need Kyrie Irving For Title Run
stories.summary: Tim Hardaway Sr. asserts that the Dallas Mavericks must keep Kyrie Irving to secure a top playoff seed. Sitting at 7-5, the team relies heavily on Irving's production alongside Cooper Flagg to remain competitive.

stories.headline: Bengals Named Potential Landing Spot For Tight End Sam LaPorta
stories.summary: Following an impressive start to the 2026 season, the Cincinnati Bengals are emerging as a suitor for Detroit Lions tight end Sam LaPorta. As LaPorta navigates a contract standoff, his impending free agency could give Joe Burrow another elite weapon.

stories.headline: Steelers vs. Bengals prediction, odds, time: NFL Week 10 'Sunday Night Football' picks by advanced model
Bears Urged To Secure Contract Extensions For Key Linemen
stories.summary: With quarterback Caleb Williams playing on an affordable rookie contract, the Chicago Bears possess the necessary cap space to lock down vital players. Analysts argue that extending linemen Theo Benedet and Jonah Jackson should be an immediate priority.

stories.headline: Market Expert Jay Ritter Warns Of Anthropic IPO Valuation Risks
stories.summary: Renowned IPO expert Jay Ritter is sounding the alarm over Anthropic's upcoming public market debut. As the five-year-old creator of Claude targets a massive initial valuation, investors face looming questions about potential returns.

stories.headline: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Other AI Giants Face Lawsuit Demanding Development Freeze
Proposed Trade Sends Josh Hart Back to Lakers
stories.summary: A podcast proposal suggests the New York Knicks ship Josh Hart to the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for Jaden Hardy, Kevon Looney, Jake LaRavia, and three second-round picks. The deal aims to give L.A. much-needed wing depth while helping the Knicks shed salary. Analysts note the framework makes sense for both sides as the unofficial trade season approaches.

stories.headline: Four Potential Trade Landing Spots for Aaron Gordon
stories.summary: Denver Nuggets forward Aaron Gordon is facing an uncertain future with the franchise. Analysts have outlined four realistic trade destinations aimed at helping the Nuggets acquire younger talent, reliable outside shooting, and additional draft capital.

stories.headline: Joanna Stern Reviews Apple's New HomeView
stories.summary: A detailed technical review highlights the real-world performance and design of Apple's latest smart home entry. The evaluation covers daily usability, hardware build quality, and integration within the broader Apple ecosystem.

stories.headline: Jason Snell Reviews the $299 Apple HomeView
stories.summary: Apple's $299 HomeView finalmente arrives as a 5.73-inch square kitchen display that easily outperforms sluggish competitors like the Google Nest and Amazon Echo Show. While its interface borrows heavily from watchOS, iOS, and tvOS, the snappy hardware and stellar touchscreen make it a keeper despite early software quirks.

stories.headline: Microsoft Blames Network Upgrade for Major Cloud Outage
stories.summary: Microsoft confirmed that a recent cloud outage was triggered by complications during an earlier network capacity upgrade that surfaced after a fresh network change. The company explicitly ruled out cyberattacks or AI agent involvement, opting for a gradual, stability-validated recovery process.

stories.headline: PWM Sensitivity Plagues New MacBook Pro
stories.summary: Owners of the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display are reporting severe eye strain and nausea, likely linked to the screen's Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) dimming. Despite the display's high-end contrast and touch capabilities, the flickering effect has led some users to return their devices.

stories.headline: Iran Targets US Radar Base in Bahrain
stories.summary: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launched a drone strike against a US air defense radar facility in Bahrain, marking the second such attack in three days. While Bahraini forces intercepted the drones, the incident escalates ongoing tensions regarding control of the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.headline: Hungarian Authorities Seize $20M in Probe of Orbán-Era Minister
stories.summary: Hungarian investigators uncovered nearly $20 million in cash hidden in farm buildings and buried in forests during a corruption probe into former national development minister Miklós Seszták. The raids form part of Prime Minister Péter Magyar's sweeping anti-corruption crackdown following a landslide election.

stories.headline: Democrats Break GOP Legislative Dominance
stories.summary: The 2026 midterm elections saw Democrats flip several state legislatures, ending long-standing Republican control in states like Pennsylvania, Texas, and Georgia. These shifts are expected to prioritize policy changes regarding healthcare access and school voucher limitations.

stories.headline: Smart Node Brings Self-Hosted AI Agent Crews to Small Businesses
stories.summary: Developer Dmytro Klymentiev has released Smart Node, a self-hosted AI orchestrator designed to run locally on Debian or Ubuntu machines via Docker. While application data and documents remain entirely on-premise, the tool routes core reasoning tasks through cloud providers like Anthropic, Google, and OpenRouter. It supports multiple communication channels, including Slack, Telegram, email, and live browser voice.

stories.headline: Clice v1.0 Launches as Modern C++ Language Server
stories.summary: After two and a half years of development and extensive alpha testing, clice has reached its v1.0 milestone. Built entirely on modern C++23 standards, coroutines, and named modules, the LLVM-backed tool completely redesigns architectural bottlenecks found in older language servers like clangd.

stories.headline: Advanced Betting Model Releases Week 10 Pick for 49ers vs. Cowboys
stories.summary: A sophisticated predictive model has finalized its game outcome projections for the upcoming NFL Week 10 matchup between the San Francisco 49ers and the Dallas Cowboys. Bettors are heavily scrutinizing the latest odds and spread movements as game time approaches. The computer simulation highlights key statistical edges for evaluating the matchup.

stories.headline: Advocate Argues All AI-Generated Code Must Be Open Source
stories.summary: A software essay contends that code produced by artificial intelligence ought to be strictly open-sourced or placed in the public domain. The argument cites legal precedents that deny copyright to non-human works alongside ethical concerns over models scraping open-source repositories without attribution. Requiring open licensing would prevent closed-source entities from laundering collective community knowledge into proprietary software.

stories.headline: Proven Model Issues Monday Night Football Predictions for Chargers vs. Ravens
stories.summary: An analytical betting model has revealed its projected outcome for the Week 10 Monday Night Football showdown between the Los Angeles Chargers and the Baltimore Ravens. The breakdown evaluates current team momentum, betting lines, and critical player matchups. Fans and sports gamblers are using the data to lock in late-week wagers.

stories.headline: LaMelo Ball Outshines D’Angelo Russell's Past Timberwolves Stint
stories.summary: Minnesota Timberwolves fans are drawing comparisons between point guards LaMelo Ball and D’Angelo Russell, despite drastically different early results. While Russell's turbulent initial tenure ended in frustration and a playoff benching, Ball has led Minnesota to a strong 9-3 start. The stark contrast highlights how quickly a franchise's fortunes can shift with the right floor general.

stories.headline: SpaceX Commits Over $74 Billion to Massive AI Supercomputing Centers
stories.summary: SpaceX is pouring vast capital into artificial intelligence infrastructure by funding two major supercomputing campuses in Texas and Arizona. The Starbase site in Texas will rely on an independent, on-site natural gas power plant generating up to 748 megawatts. The massive financial pivot underscores how central AI operations have become to the aerospace company's business model.

stories.headline: Expert on 34-18 Run Drops Sunday Night Football Pick for Bengals vs. Steelers
stories.summary: A handicapping expert riding a hot 34-18 streak has shared their official prediction for the upcoming Sunday Night Football clash between the Cincinnati Bengals and the Pittsburgh Steelers. The breakdown factors in current line movements, injury reports, and divisional dynamics. Bettors are tracking the expert's insights ahead of kickoff.

stories.headline: 2026 College Football Market Forecasts
stories.summary: Neil Paine provides an updated tracker for the 2026 college football season, featuring aggregated betting odds and win projections. The report also includes quarterback value rankings based on a points-above-replacement metric.

stories.headline: Bompastor's Early Substitution Propels Chelsea Past Manchester City to WSL Summit
stories.summary: Chelsea manager Sonia Bompastor made the bold tactical decision to pull struggling defender Kadeisha Buchanan just 12 minutes into the match against Manchester City. The risky move paid off as substitute Veerle Buurman locked down City's attack, paving the way for a 1-0 victory that puts Chelsea at the top of the Women's Super League.

stories.headline: Revisiting Pearl Jam's 'Yield'
stories.summary: Pitchfork re-evaluates Pearl Jam's 1998 album 'Yield,' positioning it as the band's most compelling work. The review explores how the album reflects the group's maturation and emotional navigation following the intense fame and personal tragedies of their early career.

stories.headline: Simon Willison Releases datasette-llm 0.1a11 with OpenAI-Compatible Support
stories.summary: The latest datasette-llm update introduces native support for OpenAI-compatible API endpoints, allowing developers to configure Datasette with local AI tools. Users can now easily run local models hosted via platforms like LM Studio, Ollama, or llama.cpp directly within their workflows.

stories.headline: Datasette‑vega 0.7 released, adds Vega‑Lite charts to Datasette Lite
stories.summary: Simon Willison announced the first update to the long‑dormant datasette‑vega plugin since July 2018. Version 0.7 upgrades compatibility with the newest Datasette alphas, adds cosmetic tweaks and, for the first time, works in Datasette Lite, which now supports JavaScript plugins. The README demo link points to a live Datasette Lite example.

stories.headline: Judge Refuses to Dismiss DRAM Price-Fixing Class Action Against Major Chipmakers
stories.summary: A federal judge has denied a joint motion by Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron to dismiss an antitrust lawsuit alleging a conspiracy to restrict conventional DRAM supplies. The court found that production cuts, fab delays, and a capacity shift toward high bandwidth memory plausibly suggest an unlawful agreement.

stories.headline: Retrocomputing Discussion Explores How Wozniak Created Apple 1 BASIC Early
stories.summary: A Retrocomputing Stack Exchange thread examines the historical timeline of how Steve Wozniak managed to write the Apple 1 BASIC interpreter before the physical computer had even been fully constructed. Enthusiasts analyze the development methods and emulation techniques available during the early days of microcomputing.

stories.headline: LSU Guard MiLaysia Fulwiley Arrested Following Vehicle Incident
stories.summary: LSU women's basketball player MiLaysia Fulwiley was taken into custody in Baton Rouge. Authorities state she allegedly struck a police officer with her car and subsequently fled the scene. The developing situation creates significant concerns for the LSU program as details regarding the charges emerge.
